title: Manual bg entries not added as a treatment in NS
body:
xDrip+ only submits a mbg entry to nightscout on upload and not a treatment entry. If you enter a BG via nightscout care portal, it creates both a mbg entry and a treatment entry. 

This is important if you want to see your BGs (entered from xDrip+) on the nightscout treatment report.  The other values that xDrip+ uploads (such as carbs, insulin, etc) show up correctly since they are only treatments.

comments.body: I have switched to using a bluetooth meter and these BG entries also do not get registered in nightscout as a treatment either.

Looking at the code - NightscoutUploader.java only sends BGs to nightscout as entries.  The requested change would send the (meter) BG values to nightscout as treatments as well.  There is already code to handle insulin and carbs to be uploaded as treatments.

@biomesh Is this still the case?  If not, would you please update the behavior with more recent releases of xDrip?
Thanks

I have not used xdrip since the dexcom g6 was released.

You can close this unless someone else wants to validate this issue with
the newer builds.
